title: Invalid full-matrix control evidence can retain pass status and permit evidence-only reclassification
title_de: Ungültige Full-Matrix-Control-Evidence kann den Status pass behalten und eine reine Evidence-Reklassifizierung erlauben
trust_boundary: full-matrix summary JSON produced by connector CI runs and consumed as merge-readiness classification evidence
sink: the downstream all-pass gates in apply_semicolon_collection_semantics_classification() and apply_collection_name_case_semantics_classification(), which can reclassify mismatches as documentation-only evidence
summary: At Parent source revision 9f23ae2c5fe908cef38f203be03f93fda75a8dd7, full_matrix_case_control_evidence() preserves a producer status of pass in its fallback even when the required 403/live predicate is false. Both downstream classifiers accept every record whose emitted status equals pass. A focused pre-fix regression reproduced the non-live bypass; the adjacent wrong-actual-status input follows the same fallback. This is a bounded CI evidence-integrity failure, not a demonstrated runtime HTTP-enforcement bypass or external attacker path.
summary_de: Auf Parent-Source-Revision 9f23ae2c5fe908cef38f203be03f93fda75a8dd7 bewahrt full_matrix_case_control_evidence() im Fallback einen Producer-Status pass, obwohl das erforderliche 403/live-Prädikat falsch ist. Beide Downstream-Classifiers akzeptieren jeden Record, dessen ausgegebener Status pass ist. Eine fokussierte Pre-Fix-Regression reproduzierte den Non-Live-Bypass; der benachbarte Input mit falschem Actual-Status folgt demselben Fallback. Dies ist ein begrenzter CI-Evidence-Integrity-Fehler, kein belegter Runtime-HTTP-Enforcement-Bypass oder externer Angreiferpfad.
observed_behavior: For a summary record with status=pass, expected_status=403, actual_status=403, and live_executed=false, the helper's success predicate is false but its fallback emits status=pass. The retained focused unit then fails because it requires status=fail. A record with status=pass, expected_status=403, actual_status=200, and live_executed=true follows the same fallback and is also exposed as pass. The downstream gates check only emitted status.
observed_behavior_de: Für einen Summary-Record mit status=pass, expected_status=403, actual_status=403 und live_executed=false ist das Erfolgsprädikat des Helpers falsch, aber sein Fallback gibt status=pass aus. Die aufbewahrte fokussierte Unit schlägt deshalb fehl, weil sie status=fail verlangt. Ein Record mit status=pass, expected_status=403, actual_status=200 und live_executed=true folgt demselben Fallback und wird ebenfalls als pass ausgegeben. Die Downstream-Gates prüfen nur den ausgegebenen Status.
expected_behavior: A control record may be emitted as pass only when status=pass, expected=403, actual-or-observed=403, and live_executed is true. Any failed predicate must emit a non-passing control state so neither downstream classifier may reclassify a mismatch as documentation-only evidence. Valid live 403 controls and existing missing or blocked evidence remain visible with compatible fields.
expected_behavior_de: Ein Control-Record darf nur als pass ausgegeben werden, wenn status=pass, expected=403, actual-oder-observed=403 und live_executed true ist. Jedes fehlgeschlagene Prädikat muss einen nicht erfolgreichen Control-Status ausgeben, damit keiner der Downstream-Classifier einen Mismatch als reine Dokumentations-Evidence reklassifizieren kann. Gültige Live-403-Controls sowie bestehende Missing- oder Blocked-Evidence bleiben mit kompatiblen Feldern sichtbar.
impact: Malformed, stale, or otherwise untrustworthy CI producer evidence can make a false allow or non-live control appear sufficient for an evidence-only reclassification, potentially lowering a generated mismatch report's criticality or merge-readiness signal. The available evidence does not show request-path enforcement bypass, direct attacker control in hosted CI, source-code execution, filesystem access, secrets exposure, or a production security vulnerability.
impact_de: Fehlerhafte, veraltete oder anderweitig nicht vertrauenswürdige CI-Producer-Evidence kann ein False-Allow oder ein Non-Live-Control für eine reine Evidence-Reklassifizierung ausreichend erscheinen lassen und dadurch potenziell die Kritikalität eines generierten Mismatch-Reports oder sein Merge-Readiness-Signal senken. Die verfügbare Evidence zeigt keinen Request-Path-Enforcement-Bypass, keine direkte Angreiferkontrolle in Hosted CI, keine Source-Code-Ausführung, keinen File-Zugriff, keine Secret-Exposition und keine Produktions-Sicherheitslücke.
preconditions: A full-matrix summary case reaches full_matrix_case_control_evidence().
The producer record declares status pass but violates at least one of expected=403, actual-or-observed=403, or live_executed=true.
A downstream collection-semantics classifier evaluates the resulting control-evidence map.
reproduction: At source revision 9f23ae2c5fe908cef38f203be03f93fda75a8dd7, run tests.test_report_conditional_remediation.ReportConditionalRemediationTest.test_full_matrix_control_evidence_keeps_fixed_case_and_fallback_contracts with the retained pre-fix assertions.
The test supplies a pass/403/403/non-live HAProxy producer record and requires a non-passing result. The unpatched helper returns pass and the test exits 1.
The same test contains an adjacent pass/403/200/live input, which exercises the wrong-actual-status bypass after the first negative assertion is corrected.

evidence.result: The pre-fix regression expected fail but observed pass for status=pass, expected_status=403, actual_status=403, live_executed=false.

evidence.command: rtk proxy bash -lc 'PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX=<task-pycache> TMPDIR=<task-tmp> /root/git/ModSecurity-conector/.venv/bin/python -m unittest tests.test_report_conditional_remediation.ReportConditionalRemediationTest.test_full_matrix_control_evidence_keeps_fixed_case_and_fallback_contracts'
evidence.result: After the focused fallback normalization, valid live-403 controls remain pass while pass/403/403/non-live and pass/403/200/live controls are fail.
Complete two-path local security diff scan; no reportable diff-induced finding and no weakened source, path, output, or classifier control.

root_cause: full_matrix_case_control_evidence() uses the producer status unchanged in the fallback branch after the stricter four-part predicate fails. Its consumers use the emitted status as the all-pass gate, so a producer-declared pass can bypass the stricter predicate.
root_cause_de: full_matrix_case_control_evidence() verwendet im Fallback-Zweig den Producer-Status unverändert, nachdem das strengere vierteilige Prädikat fehlschlägt. Seine Consumer verwenden den ausgegebenen Status als All-Pass-Gate, so dass ein vom Producer erklärtes pass das strengere Prädikat umgehen kann.
proposed_remediation: Keep the existing success predicate and compatibility wrapper, but normalize an unsafe fallback producer status pass to fail whenever that predicate is not met. Add direct regressions for non-live pass and wrong-actual pass inputs, keep a legitimate live 403 pass control, and run the focused report test, syntax validation, bypass review, and exact-head hosted checks. Do not weaken evidence predicates, safe-root controls, scanner rules, exclusions, suppressions, or Quality Gates.
proposed_remediation_de: Das bestehende Erfolgsprädikat und den Kompatibilitäts-Wrapper beibehalten, aber einen unsicheren Fallback-Producer-Status pass zu fail normalisieren, sobald dieses Prädikat nicht erfüllt ist. Direkte Regressionen für Non-Live-pass- und Wrong-Actual-pass-Inputs ergänzen, ein legitimes Live-403-pass-Control erhalten und den fokussierten Report-Test, Syntax-Validierung, Bypass-Review und Exact-Head-Hosted-Checks ausführen. Evidence-Prädikate, Safe-Root-Controls, Scanner-Regeln, Exclusions, Suppressions oder Quality Gates nicht abschwächen.
acceptance_criteria: The pass/403/403/non-live control record is emitted as non-passing and cannot satisfy either all-pass classification gate.
The pass/403/200/live control record is emitted as non-passing and cannot satisfy either all-pass classification gate.
A legitimate pass/403/403/live control record remains emitted as pass with compatible evidence fields.
The compatibility wrapper and parameterized helper remain equivalent for ARGS_NAMES_CONTROL_CASE.
Focused tests, syntax checks, final security/bypass review, and exact-head hosted PR checks are recorded without weakening any control.
validation_plan: Run the retained baseline regression and retain its failure receipt.
Apply the smallest helper fallback normalization and rerun the same focused test with both invalid inputs and a valid live 403 control.
Inspect both downstream all-pass consumers and run a focused bypass review for actual_status and observed_status variants.
Run focused test-module, Python compilation, diff checks, and a final security-diff review of the changed source and test paths.
After Draft-PR delivery, observe exact-head GitHub checks and SonarQube Cloud new-issue and new-duplication measures.
regression_tests: test_full_matrix_control_evidence_keeps_fixed_case_and_fallback_contracts: pass/403/403/non-live and pass/403/200/live records must be non-passing.
legitimate_control_tests: test_full_matrix_control_evidence_keeps_fixed_case_and_fallback_contracts: pass/403/403/live Apache and observed-status NGINX controls remain pass.
The fixed wrapper remains exactly equivalent to the parameterized helper for ARGS_NAMES_CONTROL_CASE.

history.detail: A focused unit demonstrated that a producer-declared pass with live_executed=false is still emitted as pass after the helper predicate rejects it.
The correction is limited to the selected Parent CI helper and its direct regression test; delivery remains a separate Draft-PR outcome.

The shared fallback now converts an invalid producer pass to fail. The retained post-fix regression, the full 11-test module, selected Python compilation, diff hygiene, and a complete two-path local security diff scan passed. Exact Draft-PR head, hosted SonarQube Cloud, and resulting-master reproduction evidence remain required before verified or closed.

Draft PR #178 is open and draft at 178f0f9b965f75982230ef855fe386474e9a4652, identical to the local and remote branch head. GitHub reports 33 passed and zero failed checks.
